summary.text: Boyd Wiggam is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Boyd Wiggam graduated from Burns High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 1995, and received a law degree from the College of William & Mary in 2005.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised on a farm in eastern Laramie County and studied economic development planning in graduate school at the University of Nebraska.

He said he returned to Wyoming in 2013 with his wife and children, maintains a private law practice that helps people in financial distress file for bankruptcy, and works on a portion of his family's farm north of Hillsdale raising dryland wheat.
Wiggam said his campaign focuses on jobs and economic development, education including expanded school choice, and access to health care.
He listed economic development, property rights, education and family as his policy interests.
